catalogue: Illustrative product photos keyed to the 4-digit EPB HS heading, one per heading, shared by every supplier who exports that line until the supplier uploads their own (V2).
coverage: The 46 headings with 20 or more exporters on EPB pages (2,440 exporters, 210 distinct codes, read 18 Sep 2026). A heading not in this file has no photo: the tile shows the code on the sunken ground.

generator.style_prompt_suffix: ghost mannequin (or flat lay for small pieces), front view, centred, soft even studio light, plain warm off-white seamless background (#F6F5F1), no model, no logos, no text, no props, sharp fabric texture, consistent series style
generator.usage_rule: Illustrative catalogue photo keyed to an HS chapter heading, never presented as the supplier's own product. The UI labels it 'Photos are illustrative'. In V2 a supplier-attested upload replaces it.
generator.note: cdn_base + file is the 1024px PNG; replace .png with _min.webp for the CDN's small copy. The CDN host is blocked from the design sessions' networks: download the 34 files with local=null from the Higgsfield gallery into this folder as hs-<code>.png (or the _min.webp as hs-<code>.min.webp); build.py finds either. The first 12 live beside the aboni-knitwear manifest.

ordering_rule: A supplier's strip and thumbs show its lines least-common first (by `exporters`), so neighbouring cards lead with different garments; a line with no photo keeps its place and shows the code only.
